name: AI Playground
author: Uwe Bruckhaus
description: Try out the AI agents on your computer, a test per tab: play chess against Claude Code, Codex, Hermes or Pi (or replay a game read from a video), compare speed and cost, judge two answers blind, test vision with a picture, make pictures from text on your own GPU (stable-diffusion.cpp, nothing leaves the computer) and ask your local LLMs with tokens per second. Goes with AI Agents Map. 8 languages.
